chest.note: a household chest (#268, Michael 2026-10-24): a little food, cloth, a rag; weights out of 32, so a weight is a chance in 32 a roll (the OSRS reading: bread 3/32, cheese 1/16); bread and cheese at about a third of their old share (#264); no weapon, tool, bag, hat, or belt in any rolled table

coop.note: docs/45 section 3: a coop holds only what its hens lay (an egg, a feather), so its table is empty (the placeholder of #333 emptied, 2026-10-25)

feed_trough.note: docs/45 section 3: a feeding trough starts empty; a player fills it with feed

barrel.note: one or two apples, or a waterskin (#264, #268): weights out of 32

wheelbarrow.note: the wheelbarrow's own grid, one big container carried like a barrel, empty (docs/30 section 9.1; it rolled the dev kit until 2026-10-15, the wiki census's bugs)

barn_rack.note: the great barn's tool rack at Hollow Farm (#201): a hoe, the one farm tool made of wood, a way into farming on the first day; the scythe is the smithy's (#200); with the valley's one found leather belt and pair of work gloves (#268), both also made at Crafting 3

granary_hollow.note: Hollow Farm's granary (#201): seed of every crop, never refilled (the fields are the renewable source: a harvest gives seed back)

granary_mill.note: the mill's granary (#201): seed of every crop, mostly rye; never refilled

dev_kit.note: the dev chest by the well: every weapon, the same each time (docs/21); two Developer Bags first (Michael, 2026-10-13), one spear fewer to make room; the two rugs, then the eight paintings, last, to try laying and hanging them (#327, #326); the grid grew from 10 by 8 to 10 by 14 to hold them

pantry.note: shelves and cupboards, a household's pantry (#268): weights out of 32

woodpile.note: logs and sticks (#268): weights out of 32

market.note: carts and stalls, goods for market (#268): weights out of 32

study.note: bookcases and desks: nothing until books are items (#268)

strongbox.note: a strongbox: a gem or a trinket once they exist (#268, #281, #282); empty until then

coffin.note: grave goods (#268): nothing or a rag, and rarely a dirk; weights out of 32

inn_counter.note: the inn's counter (#268): weights out of 32

toll_chest.note: the toll house's chest (#268): the valley's found sword and mace until the castle's armoury is built; every melee weapon is also made (#275)

scarecrow.note: Hollow Farm's scarecrow wears the Onion-head Hat, the only one (#268)
